rachel.cs: Quick sync 9: Helix Labs accepted the Preview slot but asked for a compact 30-day adoption plan focusing on search relevance and cost savings.

ben.se: Great. I'm free Mon/Wed mornings PST for the kickoff. Do we know if they'll start on Hosted?

rachel.cs: Yes Hosted for the first 2 weeks, then they'll evaluate Dedicated. Renewal risk: elevated unless we show impact quickly.

diego.eng: From infra, we'll need to enable verbose logs and reserve a small Dedicated instance for the final week. Also request their sample payloads to estimate token budget.

nina.ps: I'll draft an eval set (150 queries, 3 intents) and a short prompt playbook with quantization tips. ETA: EOD Tue.

ben.se: I'll run the demo (auth, sample prompts, rerank, fallback). Can someone share the onboarding checklist?

rachel.cs: Checklist snippet:
```
- send prep note
- invite workspace
- grant preview API key
- run health curl
- collect baseline latency/tokens
```

diego.eng: Provisioned 3 preview seats and enabled request logging. Will run a smoke test and post results. Ping me once you have their preview host.

nina.ps: Recommend starting with quantized 13B for prototypes to balance cost/latency. I'll include token estimates per intent.

scheduling-bot: Meeting created: Helix Labs Preview Kickoff  
Tue 2025-06-10 09:00 PDT  
zoom://meet/555666777 :calendar:

rachel.cs: Sent prep note to Helix and asked for 3 anonymized payloads + SA email for logs access. Also suggested KPIs: precision@5 > 0.55 and p95 latency < 350ms for hosted.

ben.se: I'll prepare 3 demo prompts highlighting routing + rerank. Diego, can you confirm Dedicated slot for week4?

diego.eng: Confirmed. Reserved small GPU node week4 and will enable end-to-end tracing during load test.

rachel.cs: Action items logged: @ben.se demo, @nina.ps eval set + playbook, @diego.eng infra checks. We'll reconvene 24h before kickoff to validate smoke tests.

rachel.cs: Thanks all :party_parrot:
